answer: Based on the data, the average monthly revenue decreased across all store types from 2022 to 2023. Convenience stores generated the highest average monthly revenue in both years, dropping from $15,914.67 in 2022 to $14,881.74 in 2023. During the same period, Discount stores went from $13,206.19 to $13,122.83, Hypermarkets from $12,657.14 to $12,383.27, and Supermarkets from $12,829.11 to $12,668.38.

prompt: Compare average monthly revenue between store types for 2022 and 2023
sql_query: SELECT st.store_type AS store_type, s.yr AS year, ROUND(AVG(s.monthly_revenue), 2) AS avg_monthly_revenue FROM (SELECT Store_Number, YEAR(CAST(Sold_Date AS DATE)) AS yr, DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(Sold_Date AS DATE)) AS month_trunc, SUM(Total_Sale_Value) AS monthly_revenue FROM sales WHERE YEAR(CAST(Sold_Date AS DATE)) IN (2022, 2023) GROUP BY Store_Number, yr, month_trunc) s JOIN stores st ON s.Store_Number = st.Store_Number GROUP BY st.store_type, s.yr ORDER BY st.store_type, year
